prompt:
ENG-G05 (cascaded shadow maps for the directional key light): the shadow pass now runs once per view AND per cascade (ShadowMap::kCascades = 4 per view, nearest first), each into its own tile of the map: tile = viewIndex * ShadowMap::kCascades + cascade. Application::run's frame: compute the cascades of each view and draw each into its tile. Three places, nothing else changes:
1. Replace the block that starts with the comment `// Real shadow mapping (see kke::ShadowMap) — computed from the` and ends with the line `const glm::mat4& lightViewProj = lightViewProjs[0];` (the comment, the setTiles line, the lightViewProjs array and its loop) with:
   a. A comment: cascaded shadow maps (kke::ShadowMap) from the key light (lights[0]) only. Each view's frustum, out to kShadowDistance, is cut into ShadowMap::kCascades slices, nearest first, each drawn into its own tile of the map, so near shadows are sharp and far ones still exist. lightViewProjs[i] is view i's far cascade; the nearer ones are it scaled and shifted (ShadowMap::cascadeScaleOffset), which is how the shaders pick one. Every cascade is snapped to its own texels so edges don't shimmer as the camera moves. Split screen: each view has its own cascades, framed on its own camera.
   b. `constexpr float kShadowDistance = 80.0f;`
   c. `if (m_shadowMap->setTiles(viewCount * ShadowMap::kCascades)) writeShadowMapDescriptor();`
   d. `std::array<glm::mat4, kMaxViews> lightViewProjs;` and `std::array<std::array<glm::mat4, ShadowMap::kCascades>, kMaxViews> cascadeViewProjs;` and `std::array<std::array<glm::vec4, ShadowMap::kCascades>, kMaxViews> cascadeScaleOffsets, cascadeTiles;`
   e. `const glm::vec3 lightDir = m_lighting.lights[0].direction;` and `const uint32_t tileRes = m_shadowMap->tileResolution();`
   f. A loop `for (uint32_t i = 0; i < viewCount; ++i) {` with, in order: `const DrawView& d = drawViews[i];`; `glm::vec3 forward = d.camera.target - d.camera.position;` and `if (glm::dot(forward, forward) < 1e-12f) forward = glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, -1.0f);`; the lens from the projection (it already handles tall screens): `const float tanHalfFovY = 1.0f / std::abs(d.proj[1][1]);` and `const float aspect = std::abs(d.proj[1][1] / d.proj[0][0]);`; `const auto spheres = ShadowMap::cascadeSpheres(d.camera.position, forward, tanHalfFovY, aspect, d.camera.nearPlane, std::min(d.camera.farPlane, kShadowDistance));`; `const glm::vec4& far = spheres[ShadowMap::kCascades - 1];`; `lightViewProjs[i] = ShadowMap::computeLightViewProj(lightDir, glm::vec3(far), far.w, tileRes);`; then an inner loop `for (uint32_t c = 0; c < ShadowMap::kCascades; ++c) {` that sets `cascadeScaleOffsets[i][c] = c + 1 == ShadowMap::kCascades ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f) : ShadowMap::cascadeScaleOffset(lightViewProjs[i], lightDir, far.w, glm::vec3(spheres[c]), spheres[c].w, tileRes);`, `cascadeViewProjs[i][c] = ShadowMap::cascadeViewProj(lightViewProjs[i], cascadeScaleOffsets[i][c]);` and `cascadeTiles[i][c] = m_shadowMap->tileRect(i * ShadowMap::kCascades + c);`. Close both loops.
   g. Keep the line `const glm::mat4& lightViewProj = lightViewProjs[0];` last.
2. In the call `drawViews[i].lighting->update(m_lighting, drawViews[i].camera.position, lightViewProjs[i], drawViews[i].proj * drawViews[i].view, skyEnv, m_shadowMap->tileRect(i));` replace the last argument `m_shadowMap->tileRect(i)` with the two arguments `cascadeTiles[i].data(), cascadeScaleOffsets[i].data()`.
3. In the shadow pass, the loop `for (uint32_t i = 0; i < viewCount; ++i) {` that holds `if (viewCount > 1) m_shadowMap->beginTile(cmd, i);`: its body becomes an inner loop `for (uint32_t c = 0; c < ShadowMap::kCascades; ++c) {` containing `const uint32_t tile = i * ShadowMap::kCascades + c;`, `m_shadowMap->beginTile(cmd, tile);` (always, no `if`), `shadowCtx.lightViewProj = cascadeViewProjs[i][c];`, `shadowCtx.viewIndex = i;`, `shadowCtx.cascade = c;`, `shadowCtx.tile = tile;` and the existing `for (Module* m : m_initOrder) { safeInvoke(m, "renderShadow", ...); }` loop unchanged.
